本集為系統測試示範集：透過一句中文、再一句英文的方式，帶你速覽 Reddit 熱門冷知識與科技話題。

今日話題來源 (Sources)

  • Reddit r/todayilearned & r/technology Highlights

中英雙語逐字稿 (Bilingual Transcript)

1. 歡迎收聽每日五分鐘雙語精華，一起用輕鬆的方式聽新聞學英文。
Welcome to the Daily Five-Minute Bilingual Highlights, where we learn English effortlessly through trending stories.

2. 今天我們從 Reddit 上挑選了幾個討論度極高的有趣話題。
Today we have handpicked several fascinating topics that are trending heavily on Reddit.

3. 首先在今日冷知識看板上，有網友分享了一個關於海洋生物的驚人發現。
First up on the Today I Learned board, a user shared an amazing discovery about marine life.

4. 科學家發現，章魚其實擁有三個心臟，而且牠們的血液是藍色的。
Scientists found that octopuses actually have three hearts, and their blood is blue.

5. 留言區的網友幽默地表示，難怪章魚面對壓力時比人類還要冷靜。
Commenters joked that this explains why octopuses stay much calmer under pressure than humans do.

6. 接著在科技看板上，大家正熱烈討論人工智慧語音技術的最新進展。
Next on the technology board, people are actively discussing the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence voice synthesis.

7. 現在我們只需要簡單的腳本，就能每天自動把全球趣聞轉換成雙語廣播節目。
Now with just a simple script, we can automatically turn global stories into a daily bilingual podcast.

8. 以上就是今天的示範內容，感謝你的收聽，我們明天見！
That wraps up today's demo episode, thank you for listening, and see you tomorrow!

item.content:encoded:
哈囉，各位聽眾！今天是二零二六年十一月十三日，歡迎收聽每日五分鐘雙語精華。今天我們將聊聊經典歌曲《Play That Funky Music》的爆笑創作故事、圈養虎鯨令人心疼的牙齒問題，以及北韓駭客如何利用假視訊電話詐騙四億美元加密貨幣。精彩內容，不容錯過！

今日話題來源 (Sources)

  • TIL the song Play That Funky Music by Wild Cherry came about when they were playing for a mostly Black crowd and during a break a patron asked "Are you going to play some funky music, white boys?" so they wrote up the song in 5 minutes.
  • TIL captive orcas frequently have worn-down, broken, or intentionally drilled teeth because they chew and grind on concrete pool walls and steel gates out of stress and boredom
  • North Korean hackers used fake video calls in $400m crypto hack, says FBI

中英雙語逐字稿 (Bilingual Transcript)

1. 哈囉各位聽眾，歡迎收聽二零二六年十一月十三日的每日五分鐘雙語精華。
Hey everyone, welcome to today's five-minute bilingual highlights on November thirteenth, two thousand twenty-six.

2. 我是你們的主持人，今天我們要深入探討三個超有趣又發人深省的話題。
I'm your host, and today we're diving into three super interesting and thought-provoking topics.

3. 從一首經典放克歌曲的爆笑由來，到令人心疼的動物福利議題，還有最新的網路詐騙手法。
From the hilarious origin of a classic funk song to a heartbreaking animal welfare issue and the latest online scam tactics.

4. 首先，我們來聊聊一首大家耳熟能詳的經典歌曲《Play That Funky Music》。
First up, let's talk about a classic song everyone knows: "Play That Funky Music."

5. 你知道嗎？這首歌的誕生，竟然是一次超級即興的意外！
Did you know this song was born from a totally spontaneous and unexpected moment?

6. 樂團Wild Cherry當時在一個幾乎都是黑人觀眾的場合表演。
The band Wild Cherry was performing for a crowd that was mostly Black at the time.

7. 休息時，一位觀眾問：「白人小子，你們會不會玩點放克音樂啊？」
During a break, a patron asked, "Are you going to play some funky music, white boys?"

8. 結果，他們就在五分鐘內寫出了這首傳奇金曲！
And just like that, they wrote this legendary hit song in only five minutes!

9. Reddit網友們都笑翻了，說這根本是史上最棒的歌曲創作故事。
Redditors cracked up, saying it's simply the best song origin story ever.

10. 有人說：「這就是真正的觀眾參與啊！」
One user commented, "Now that's what I call true audience participation!"

11. 還有網友開玩笑說：「想像他們如果拒絕了會怎樣？」
Another Redditor joked, "Imagine what would've happened if they had said no?"

12. 真的是太有趣了，證明靈感往往來自最意想不到的地方。
It's truly fascinating, proving inspiration often strikes from the most unexpected places.

13. 接下來，我們要轉換一下心情，關注一個比較沉重的議題。
Next, we're shifting gears to focus on a more somber issue.

14. 你知道圈養的虎鯨，牠們的牙齒常常有嚴重磨損、斷裂，甚至是被鑽孔嗎？
Did you know that captive orcas often have severely worn-down, broken, or even drilled teeth?

15. 這是因為牠們在壓力大又無聊的時候，會去啃咬水泥池壁和鋼製柵欄。
This happens because, out of stress and boredom, they chew on concrete pool walls and steel gates.

16. 這真的是讓人聽了很心疼，也反映出圈養環境對牠們造成的巨大傷害。
This is truly heartbreaking and highlights the immense harm caused by captive environments.

17. Reddit上很多網友都表示很難過，認為虎鯨不該被關在水族箱裡。
Many Redditors expressed sadness, believing orcas shouldn't be kept in tanks.

18. 有人說：「這就是為什麼我們應該停止去海洋世界這種地方。」
One user stated, "This is exactly why we should stop visiting places like SeaWorld."

19. 這些討論提醒我們，要更重視動物的福利與牠們的自然棲息地。
These discussions remind us to prioritize animal welfare and their natural habitats.

20. 希望未來有更多虎鯨能回到廣闊的海洋，自由自在地生活。
Hopefully, more orcas can return to the vast ocean and live freely in the future.

21. 最後，我們要來談談一個跟網路安全有關的警訊。
Finally, let's discuss a crucial warning related to online security.

22. 美國聯邦調查局最新報告指出，北韓駭客用假視訊電話詐騙了四億美元。
The FBI's latest report reveals North Korean hackers scammed four hundred million dollars using fake video calls.

23. 這些駭客利用所謂的「變臉竊賊」手法，讓九百多名受害者上當。
These hackers used a "FaceStealer" scheme, tricking over nine hundred victims.

24. 他們會假冒成不同身份，引誘受害者加入視訊通話，然後竊取加密貨幣。
They impersonate various identities, luring victims into video calls, then stealing cryptocurrency.

25. 這類詐騙手法越來越高明，很難靠肉眼辨識真偽。
These scams are getting increasingly sophisticated, making them hard to identify visually.

26. 所以，在網路上遇到任何可疑的連結或通話請求，千萬要多方查證。
So, always double-check any suspicious links or call requests online.

27. 保護好自己的數位資產，才不會落入詐騙集團的陷阱喔。
Protect your digital assets to avoid falling into scammers' traps.

28. 今天的節目就到這裡告一段落，希望大家聽得開心也學到新東西。
That's all for today's episode; I hope you enjoyed it and learned something new.

29. 感謝收聽，別忘了訂閱我們的頻道，下週同一時間再見囉！
Thanks for tuning in, don't forget to subscribe to our channel, and see you next week!
